snippet.title: Small Dragon Big Appetite | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🐉Small Dragon Big Appetite.🐇

🎮 Link to the game: https://mo-dev.itch.io/climaxgamejamteam5

"Join Chompie as he explores the enchanted bunny kingdom, hunting down bunnies to satisfy his insatiable appetite!
How many days can you go without starving?"
- Introducing Chompie, a little dragon that roams in the bunny kingdom deep in the forest outside of the bunny society!

- Each morning he must hunt the needed amount of bunnies to satiate his appetite before the day ends. As the days go by, you must satisfy his growing appetite, as it increases daily.

- On your hunting venture, Chompie will encounter everything from humble peasants to powerful wizards and brave knights. Strategize your hunting forays, find potions that aid your hunts, unlock new areas by finding keys , and eat as many bunnies as you possibly can!

Developers note:

Initially, we thought the project would end with the game jam, but the excitement and creativity in the team were too strong to stop there. A more polished version of the game was soon in the works, and today, we're thrilled to announce its completion! This new version features refined gameplay, additional roguelike elements, and even a fully functional online scoreboard for you to test your skills against players worldwide.🐉🌍🏆
